newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia unemployment up 31.1 pct yr/yr in April.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia unemployment up 31.1 pct yr/yr in April.

text.p: Mongolia's unemployment rate had soared 31.1 percent at the end of April compared with the year-ago period, official statistics showed.
The number of unemployed economically active people rose to 63,524 at the end of April 1997, up from 48,442 at the end of the same month in 1996, the State Statistics Bulletin said.
Nearly half of the increase, or 14.65 percent, occurred in the first four months of this year. Mongolia had 55,405 jobless people at the start of the year.
In January, Mongolia had a total labour force of 1.124 million.
Mongolia had another 277,100 people of working age without jobs who were not registered among the unemployed economically active population, the State Statistics Bulletin said.
